adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the addGuests.handler.ts code. Looking at lines 85-99, the handler first persists new guests to the database (prisma.booking.update with createMany), then calls eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking). If the calendar update fails, the guests are already persisted in the database but the calendar is not synchronized. Additionally, the sendAddGuestsEmails is wrapped in try-catch that only logs errors, so emails might not be sent. On retry, the uniqueGuests filter (lines 68-72) would filter out the already-persisted guests, causing the retry to fail with 'emails_must_be_unique_valid' error. This leaves the booking in an inconsistent state with attendees in the database but not in the calendar.
